svg.aria-label: Grid of 8 rows by 64 columns of squares of varying size, the fixed coupling mask of the 8 by 64 delay tensor. Values range from 0.02 to 0.955.

g.text: 8 wires × 64 slots = 512 virtual nodes · one slot every 20 ns · 1280 ns round the loop
one square is one wire at one tick of the slot clock: a virtual node holding one number.
dither density is the fixed coupling window sigmoid(m), 0.02 to 0.955. It gates how much each node hears its
neighbours, and never changes between inputs.
all 512 states are flattened and handed to one logistic regression. Nothing else is fitted.
